payload.title: Reject fixed 50 percent surface replication
payload.decision: Reject H045/T061. The exact 50% surface projection is closed because its tail failure replicated across frozen families.
payload.rationale: A replicated aggregate gain with replicated tail failure is not a deployable improvement. Further tuning around 50% would be post-result cosmetic search.
payload.revisit_trigger: Continue only with the separately preregistered 25% tail-safe action and its stricter all-cell gates.
